senses.gloss:
नैक नैक, i. e. न-एक, adj., f. का.
 1. Many a, Mārk. P. 28, 29.
 2. pl. Many, Nal. 12, 109.
 3. Manifold, Daśak. in Chr. 198, 15.
 4. Including several matters, Yājñ. 2, 20.

नैकधा नैक + धा (or rather न-एकधा), adv.
 1. In many parts, Rām. 6, 77, 12.
 2. To many directions, Bhāg. P. 4, 5, 18.
नैकशस् नैक + शस् (or rather न-एकशस्), adv. Repeatedly, Rām. 3, 36, 21.
नैकशस्त्रमय नैक-शस्त्र + मय, adj. Consisting of many missiles, Rām. 6, 91, 20.
नैकृतिक नैकृतिक, i. e. निकृति + क, adj. Fallacious, Man. 4, 196 (read नैकृ˚, instead of निष्कृ˚).
